license_note: The repository LICENSE file puts all binary model files under the NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement and all source code files under Apache 2.0, and the model card additionally names the Llama 3.2 Community Model License for the base. All three material licences are recorded; the mix of open and restricted grants makes the release mixed-source rather than open source.

Llama 3.2 base terms named by the model card as additional governing terms

access_boundary: This record represents the llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 checkpoint. The v1 generation, larger Nemotron embedding sizes, the base Llama 3.2 weights, and NVIDIA NIM or third-party hosted endpoints are separate boundaries.
strengths: Commercial-use training blend built to avoid non-commercial dataset restrictions, documented in the model card
1B retriever that runs leanly with the licence split stated file-by-file in the repository LICENSE
tradeoffs: Three overlapping licences govern weights, base, and code, so commercial reuse needs legal review of each
No developer API or managed host serves this checkpoint, so running it is entirely self-operated
